programmes.d: The Doctor discovers the difference between the two Dalek factions.
The streets of East London shake under a civil war between the Daleks.
(1/4) The Doctor and Ace meet other visitors to the Psychic Circus on Segonax.
(2/4) Captain Cook goes to extreme measures to ensure he's not the next to face the odd family.
(3/4) Ace must stop the Chief Clown as the Doctor realizes that he is next into the ring.
(4/4) The Doctor must entertain the Gods of Ragnarok in the Dark Circus.
(1/3) Neo-Nazis are seeking the Nemesis Statue - as are Cybermen and Lady Peinforte.
(2/3) The Cybermen have the Nemesis Statue but Lady Peinforte and Richard fight back.
(3/3) The Nemesis Statue is alive and claims it has secrets to reveal.
As UNIT are transporting a nuclear warhead, knights in armor arrive to continue waging a war.
The Doctor and Ace explore King Arthur's spaceship deep under Lake Vortigern.
Furious at her inability to engage Arthur, Morgaine threatens to unleash the Destroyer.
(4/4) The Brigadier slays the Destroyer while Morgaine takes control of UNIT's warhead.
The Doctor and Ace explore Victorian house Gabriel Chase, becoming aware of dark secrets.
Both Light and Control emerge from their respective slumbers...
Ace realizes that her past actions need to be dealt with.
As Russian forces approach the English coastline, an ancient evil stirs beneath the surface of the water.
The Viking runes in the crypt contain a secret to Ace's past.
The Haemovores attack St Jude's church and the insane Millington willingly sacrifices his men.
The Ancient Haemovore stands upon the Earth once again, determined to change the future by erasing the past.
Trying to work out why people have been disappearing from Perivale, Ace is cornered.
The Doctor and a number of people from Perivale follow Ace to the Cheetah-People's world.
As the alien world dies around them, the Doctor and the Master fight like animals.
(1/7) The travelers venture out on to the surface of a new world.
The Doctor, Ian and Susan discover that they have exposed to radiation.
(7/7) The Thals and the time travellers attack the Daleks.
(3/7) Fearful of a Thal attack, the Daleks force Susan to trick the Thals.
(4/7) Pretending to be a Dalek, Ian finds that he is trapped inside the casing.
(5/7) Ian and Barbara join a Thal expedition that will penetrate the Dalek city.
(6/7) The Doctor and Susan are once again taken prisoner by the Daleks.
The Doctor and his crew get trapped inside the TARDIS after a mysterious explosion and tension mounts as everyone begins suspecting one another.
The time travellers are in grave danger as the TARDIS nears total disintegration.
